source.scope: 500 valid, distinct active no-elevation DOR parcel polygons verified in thirteen local cells around the selected Philadelphia locator. Complete pages and all fresh exact-ID geometry hashes agree. Five narrow boundary slivers remain (maximum 0.78% of the smaller parcel); no geometry repair applied. Broader city completeness and legal boundary accuracy are unverified.
